describe.description: What this monitor is: the source behind the readings, the roster, the nominal band, and a plain statement of whether the readings are real or simulated.

presence.description: Who is in which module. Read this before proposing a procedure on a volume: it is what tells you the test exposes people, and therefore that a human has to authorise it.

monitor_start.description: Open a monitoring session over the people in these modules, for the duration of a procedure. Refuses when a session is already open, and when nobody is in the modules named.

monitor_stop.description: Close the session and return its record: who was watched, by what source, and every verdict that was not nominal.

report.description: A Bluetooth gateway hands over one reading from a chest strap. Refuses a subject nobody asked to watch and a rate outside what a heart does.

state.description: Every monitored subject with their last rate, their band, and their status: nominal, out-of-band, signal-lost.

verdict.description: One line for a procedure abort list: a sustained breach, a lost signal, or someone who walked into a module under test. This slot never stops anything itself.

move.description: Put a subject in a module. The scenario uses it to walk a third person into a volume under test.
